market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$76.3K must drop ~41% to hit $45K by Dec 31, 2026. Such a drawdown would require a major macro shock or crypto-specific selloff; possible in 8 months but not the base case after ETF era. Market at 0.305 prices in more downside than I see.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tail-risk macro events (recession, regulatory) over the next 8 months.
